summary: Two locations, 74 Google reviews and online booking are good foundations, but repeated blocks, dead menus and leftover form text hold the page back.

findings.problem: The line Combat Dry, Dull Skin, Wrinkles and More. Book Now! appears seven times in a row with nothing different under it.
findings.cost: Seven identical blocks hide your services and look like an error.

findings.problem: Gallery, Careers and the service categories (Skin Tightening and Laser, Cosmetic Injectables and others) link to #, and a visible label reads Leave this field empty if you're human.
findings.cost: Dead menus and leftover form text look unfinished.
findings.fix: Working menus and a clean contact form.

findings.problem: The page says Based on 74 reviews but shows about six, writes ** EXCELLENT ** with stray asterisks, and the brand appears as Reforme Lab and Reform Lab.
findings.cost: Thin review display and slips weaken your proof.
findings.fix: A full review wall and consistent branding.

findings.problem: No before and after appears on the homepage, about 20 tiles use keyword style labels, and clinically proven outcomes sits beside a note that outcomes are not guaranteed.
findings.cost: Clients want real results, and mixed claims lower trust.

redesign: One clear page per service with a booking button on each.
A full review wall, captioned results and consistent claims.
